segments.text:
AN oath is an inuocating on god, whereby is deſired that god, who is the viewer of the harts, would bee a witneſſe vnto him that ſweareth, that he wil not lie or deceiue in that matter, whereof he ſweareth, and that God would puniſh him that ſweareth, if he doe lie or deceiue. In this definition are the other foure queſtions alſo comprehended. Furthermore an oath was ordained by God, that it might be the bond of truth betweene men, and a teſtimonie or recorde, that god is the authour and defender of the truth. An oath is oftentimes vnderſtoode and taken for the
whole worſhip of God, becauſe by whom a man ſweareth, the ſame himſelfe profeſſeth to account for god.
